article.title: Prevalence and factors associated with symptoms of common mental disorders, anxiety, depression, burnout, insomnia and stress among primary healthcare workers in Brazil: protocol for a systematic review and prevalence meta-analysis.
article.authors: Antonucci BL, Pereira GR, Rocha K
article.abstract: The mental health of primary healthcare (PHC) workers is a determinant of service quality and sustainability in the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS). Brazilian observational studies report symptoms of common mental disorders, anxiety, depression, burnout, insomnia and stress among PHC workers, but the evidence is fragmented across settings, occupational categories, instruments and time periods. This protocol describes a systematic review and prevalence meta-analysis to consolidate prevalence estimates and synthesise associated sociodemographic, occupational and organisational factors among PHC workers in Brazil.
